description: Korean long-term care insurance copay (노인장기요양 본인부담금) for 2026: home care (재가) monthly limits by grade (1: 2,512,900 … 5: 1,208,900; cognitive 676,320 KRW) at 15%, facility care (시설) daily rates (1: 93,070, 2: 86,340, 3-5: 81,540 KRW) at 20%, 40%/60% reductions, basic livelihood recipients exempt; home use above the limit and facility meals are paid in full.

dailyExtra.description: Facility non-covered cost per day such as meals (default 15,000) (KRW)

homeUse.description: Home care used per month at official fees (default: the grade limit) (KRW)

reduction.description: Copay reduction: 40%, 60%, or basic livelihood recipient (0)
